Definition: Understandability refers to how easily developers can comprehend and maintain the test code.

Task: Improve the understandability of the test `TestSymmetry010Chronology_test_adjust_toMonth.java` (path:- /Users/tenghaha/Projects/New_Agent_understandability_improvement/data/original/threeten-extra/manual/testcases/TestSymmetry010Chronology/TestSymmetry010Chronology_test_adjust_toMonth.java). The refactored code must be syntactically correct and compilable against the provided CUT signatures. Do not alter the runtime behaviour of the original test: the same methods must be called with the same arguments and produce the same expected outcomes.

The original file is dominated by ~15 unused data-provider methods and dozens of unused imports — the single `@Test` method only needs four symbols. I'll keep the exact runtime behavior but strip the dead code and add a clear explanation.Compiles cleanly. I refactored the test to keep identical runtime behavior (`Symmetry010Date.of(2000, 1, 4).with(Month.APRIL)` still asserted to throw `DateTimeException`) while removing ~15 unused data-provider methods and dozens of unused imports, and renamed the method plus added a doc comment explaining why an ISO `Month` is an invalid adjuster for the Symmetry010 calendar.
